implementation: apply the exact transpose of each active input Cayley chart to the cached QK weight in reverse chart order
apply each active output Cayley chart to the transposed QK weight in forward chart order
concatenate the folded QK weight with the unchanged dense V weight and execute one F.linear projection
preserve autograd to BlockFHT cached weights and every Cayley parameter
unchanged: 262144 tokens per update, 238 updates, and token horizon
optimizer, learning rate, warmup, decay, data, seeds, and fixed evaluations

rationale: B64/G4 is both slower and fundamentally too large, so batch tuning is closed. The B32/G8 profile attributes 97.7% of update time to forward/backward. Bilateral QK currently applies two rank-64 linear Cayley charts to every token and projects QK separately from dense V. Since both charts are linear orthogonal maps, x C_in W^T C_out is exactly F.linear(x, C_out^T W C_in^T). Folding them into the cached QK weight once per microbatch and packing QK with V removes token-wise chart work and split projection launch overhead without changing the represented function or scientific state.
